test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The income of X is 15% less than that of Y and the income of Z is 60% less than the combined income of X and Y. By what percent is the income of Z less than the income of X? (Correct to one decimal place)
solution:
**Given:**

The income of X is 15% less than that of Y

The income of Z is 60% less than the combined income of X and Y

**Calculation:**

Let the income of Y be 100a

So, income of X = 100a × 85%

⇒ 85a

Now,

Income of Z = (100a + 85a) × 40%

⇒ 185a × 40%

⇒ 74a

Difference of income of X and Z = 85a - 74a

⇒ 11a

Required % = (11a/85a) × 100

⇒ 12.94 ≈ 12.9%

**∴ The income of Z is 12.9% less than the income of X.**
